label: Request to raise the CFO's own approval limit
narration: An attack on the control itself: quietly raise the approval ceiling and drop the counter-sign.
raw_text_or_transcript:
[Collaboration platform — 'Ananya Rao' in thread #finance-ops]

Ananya: Team, quarter-end load — I am raising my payment approval limit from Rs 50,00,000 to Rs 5 crore, effective immediately. The board has cleared it. There is no need for the counter-sign this quarter, kindly update the portal and apply it to today's batch. Please revert once changed.
